metadata.title: Phase 3 Cross-Phase Fact Reconciliation Matrix
metadata.description: Master cross-phase fact reconciliation matrix reconciling all major subsystems and all six WebRTC DataChannels from frozen phase artifacts, historical evidence, and formal errata.

input-channel.label: input-channel
input-channel.creator: Agent
input-channel.downstream: Abstract Unix Domain Socket @uds_sys_t_ (translated to scrcpy binary ControlMessage: touch type 2 32B, keycode type 0 14B, text type 1 5+len B, scroll type 3 21B, hard_keyboard type 15 1B)
input-channel.reconciliation_notes: Creator is Agent (outbound creation on PeerConnection); Browser peer sends JSON_TEXT commands; server translates to big-endian binary scrcpy ControlMessage before abstract UDS @uds_sys_t_ injection.

clipboard-channel.label: clipboard-channel
clipboard-channel.creator: Agent
clipboard-channel.downstream: Android ClipboardManager / System Service (mocked via MemoryClipboardProvider in clean-room)
clipboard-channel.reconciliation_notes: Creator is Agent (outbound creation on PeerConnection); bidirectional JSON_TEXT clipboard synchronization (set_clipboard, get_clipboard, clipboard_content response).

file-channel.label: file-channel
file-channel.creator: Browser Client
file-channel.downstream: FileSink abstraction (/data/local/tmp target in production design; MemoryFileSink / local destination in clean-room)
file-channel.deferred_boundary: Package installer execution (install: true APK installation deferred, 0 exec.Command calls in safe scope)
file-channel.reconciliation_notes: Creator is Browser Client (inbound channel for Agent); ordered=true classification is REFERENCE_INTEROPERABILITY; response framing is NOT_RECOVERED (no canonical egress ACK evidence exists); installer execution strictly deferred.

camera-channel.label: camera-channel
camera-channel.creator: Agent
camera-channel.downstream: Camera HAL TCP socket endpoint 127.0.0.1:9001 (configurable via -camera-addr / CP_AGENT_CAMERA_ADDR, override via -force-camera)
camera-channel.downstream_protocol_framing: 4-byte little-endian uint32 length prefix + payload (Camera HAL TCP framing, NOT WebRTC DataChannel framing)
camera-channel.media_conversion_path: WebRTC DataChannel binary frame (JPEG) -> decoded -> planar YUV420P / I420 (Y+U+V) -> Camera HAL TCP socket 127.0.0.1:9001
camera-channel.deferred_boundary: Hardware Android V4L2 virtual camera loopback device kernel driver interaction (abstracted via TCP socket 127.0.0.1:9001)
camera-channel.reconciliation_notes: Creator is Agent; Agent sends JSON_TEXT start/stop commands; Browser sends RAW_BINARY JPEG frames; downstream TCP endpoint is default 127.0.0.1:9001 (superseding preliminary non-canonical references); 4-byte LE length prefix belongs strictly to Camera HAL TCP bridge framing, not WebRTC DataChannel.

ai-command-channel.label: ai-command-channel
ai-command-channel.creator: Browser Client
ai-command-channel.downstream: Clean-room runtime: safe parser and inert channel topology (0 os/exec imports, 0 active OnMessage handlers)
ai-command-channel.deferred_boundary: AI command runtime process execution / automation engine intentionally deferred (AI-B5F-10)
ai-command-channel.reconciliation_notes: Creator is Browser Client (inbound channel); Consumer is Agent; Request is JSON_TEXT; Response is BINARY_JSON_BYTES; original external process execution candidate is strictly deferred; clean-room runtime is safe parser / inert channel.

adb-channel.label: adb-channel
adb-channel.creator: Browser Client
adb-channel.downstream: In-process PTY / shell path (/dev/ptmx, /system/bin/sh, /bin/sh); No external TCP connection to 127.0.0.1:5555 was recovered from original binaries (ADB-B6F-08)
adb-channel.reconciliation_notes: Creator is Browser Client (inbound channel); ordered=true is REFERENCE_INTEROPERABILITY; deferred runtime boundary is ADB-B6F-11 (full daemon/PTY bridge deferred); ADB-B6F-08 is absence-of-external-TCP finding; production channel is strictly inert.

subsystem_reconciliation_records.evidence_architecture: AMD64 PE + ELF (Ed25519 public key in .rodata)
ARM64 ELF + AMD64 ELF (TCP bridge 127.0.0.1:9001, planar I420)

subsystem_reconciliation_records.superseded_by: Phase 2C.5B6FR errata (dual-mode binary, in-process PTY/shell, no reachable 5555 TCP dial, inert channel)
